description: Lists the sites on this account, newest first, so a publish can go to one of them. Returns up to 100 with the account's total; there are no pages to fetch beyond that. Use get_site for one site's settings and versions.
name: list_sites

sites.description: The account's sites, newest first — every one unless `total` is larger.

name.description: What it is called, or null when it has no name.

subdomain.description: Its subdomain, which is what `site` accepts.

total.description: How many sites the account holds. Larger than `sites` only past 100.

title: List sites
